captureLimits: Gift captures are the current passing transaction build. Flow captures predate current acting integration, toast lifetime and later source changes. They prove the pictured defects, not current full-campaign behavior.

First-frame empty text and transient title overlays are not counted as missing dialogue. No normal dialogue closeup after current acting integration was supplied, so neutral/smiling acting consistency is not accepted from these captures.
Original supplied component assets and project frame style can be compared; this review has no original V3 whole-screen runtime capture and makes no pixel-equivalence claim.

passedInSuppliedCaptures: All three new gift images show readable selected item names, quantities, confirm/defer labels and the complete gift image. No item image is clipped.

Choice, reasoning, bullet, spot and vote captures have readable primary questions and selected states. Climax three candidate illustrations are visible and distinct, though the missing full-board flow is a separate known controller requirement.
Current gift confirmation separates proposal from final handover and visibly states owned quantity.
notNewFailures: The persistent growth toast covers several old mode titles; root already fixed its common-update lifetime. Those old screenshots are not proof of a remaining current toast bug.
The oversized conclusion effect visible behind some old mode captures may be a transient transition capture; inspect a settled new frame before claiming it persists.
An angry or smiling portrait in a single old mode frame does not prove a false emotional match. Current acting needs source-aware settled dialogue captures.
